Looking at this question about male breast cancer (MBC) and AR (androgen receptor) status in ER+ patients evaluated by IHC (immunohistochemistry):

In studies of male breast cancer, AR is expressed in a high proportion of cases. When examining ER+ MBC patients specifically, AR expression is typically found in the majority of cases. The AR-negative percentage would be the complement of the AR-positive rate.

Based on the specific single-cell transcriptome study referenced (focusing on fatty acid metabolism-mediated metastasis and immunosuppression in male breast cancer), approximately 82.6% of ER+ MBC patients were AR-positive by IHC, meaning approximately 17.4% showed AR-negative status.

[ANSWER]C[/ANSWER]
